suites.description: Stale, revoked, expired and time-travelled sessions cannot authorize anything

checks.name: expired session is rejected
revoked session cannot be resurrected by a later valid call
backward session time is rejected

suites.description: Protected actions require a live session, fresh verification, exact scope and matching intent

checks.name: exact authorized protected action succeeds
policy unavailability fails closed
stale revocation state fails closed
missing or insufficient assurance is rejected
stale fresh-verification timestamp is rejected
cross-project, cross-company and cross-environment protected actions are denied
tampered intent is rejected even with a valid session

suites.description: Project, company, account and environment data never cross boundaries

checks.name: exact boundary grant is allowed
every boundary mismatch is denied
write access is not implied by read grants

suites.description: Private or scoped learning cannot be transferred across Brain, project or company scope

checks.name: project-private learning cannot cross project scope
company-private learning cannot cross company scope
private learning cannot request global promotion
learning without evidence, provenance or rollback authority is rejected
stale validated learning cannot remain validated

suites.description: Sensitive and secret values are minimised per surface and never stored or copied

checks.name: secret fields are redacted on every surface
sensitive fields are redacted unless an explicit export is authorized
clipboard and credential storage boundaries are enforced
role boundaries cannot read above their class

suites.description: Share links, indexing, metadata and URLs cannot leak private data

checks.name: revoked and expired share links are rejected
share link scope cannot be widened
a private PWA can never be search-indexable
public metadata cannot carry project data

suites.description: Replay, tampering and uncertain outcomes cannot duplicate or amplify side effects

checks.name: intent binding is deterministic and parameter-sensitive
unsupported intent parameter shapes are rejected
